reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Recorded brand property status, transfer recording, and fee
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history note (L. 1971 H.B. 134 §§ 10, 11, A.L. 1992 H.B. 878). Establishes that a brand recorded under section 268.041 is personal property subject to sale, assignment, transfer, devise, and descent, requires recording written transfer instruments with the director, and sets a $10 recording fee. Independent review added "Recorded" to preserve the statutory limitation to brands recorded under section 268.041.

headings.title: Certified copies for new brand owner
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and history note. Directs the director, once written brand transfer instruments are recorded, to furnish certified copies of the sale, assignment, or transfer to the new owner.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read both subsections and history note (L. 1971 H.B. 134 §§ 10, 11, A.L. 1992 H.B. 878); verified all source and subsection fingerprints. Checked section 268.041 recorded-brand limitation, personal-property status, written transfer recording with $10 fee, and certified copies for the new owner. Retained subsection 2; revised subsection 1 to specify "Recorded brand".

headings.title: Slaughterer records for branded animals
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history note (L. 1971 H.B. 134 § 18). Distinguished from subsection 2 by covering persons slaughtering branded cattle, sheep, horses, mules, or asses and requiring records of animal count, slaughter date, seller or customer name and address, brand, and actual or estimated weight.

headings.title: Livestock market records and brand facsimiles
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and history note. Distinguished from subsection 1 by covering livestock markets receiving branded cattle, sheep, horses, mules, or asses and requiring records of count, receipt date, sender name and address, and a facsimile of the brand.

headings.title: Minimum two-year record retention period
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and history note. Requires keeping all records mandated by section 268.171 for at least two years.

headings.title: Liability exclusion and identification-only use of brand facsimiles
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 4 and history note. Specifies that section 268.171 imposes no liability on market operators or livestock slaughterers and restricts all brand facsimiles strictly to use as identification records. Independent review replaced "disclaimer" with "exclusion" to reflect statutory phrasing ("Nothing contained in this section will impose any liability") and specified brand facsimiles.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read all four subsections and history note (L. 1971 H.B. 134 § 18); verified all source and subsection fingerprints. Checked five covered branded livestock species, distinction between slaughterer records and livestock market records with brand facsimiles, two-year retention, and no-liability/identification-only clause. Retained subsections 1–3; revised subsection 4 from "Liability disclaimer" to "Liability exclusion" and specified brand facsimiles.
